turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Taylor calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Chris Malik?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Can I also confirm the email we have on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, that's still the right one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $164.92.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm not able to pay that right now. I've been off work sick since Jul.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My husband is very sick right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm only bringing home about $3520 a month now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a note on the file so the hardship team review your situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should hear from them within a few days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll try to pay $76 Aug 16.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $75.99 on August 16. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Will you be paying through the app or banking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Through the app.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
